integrity: The sphere-to-vertex reduction is proved analytically by convexity on products of boundary edges. The bundled exact-arithmetic verifier reconstructs the finite facet branches and the sharp attaining pair. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result is an exact profile for one two-dimensional polyhedral norm and does not classify arbitrary hexagonal norms. A 2023 bulletin paper on modified von Neumann-Jordan constants of extreme absolute normalized norms may overlap with the single balanced value after affine identification; its inaccessible full text was not used to claim novelty for that isolated specialization.
title: Exact Liu–Yang parameter profile of the affine-regular hexagonal plane
